LanguageData.WR_ParentBlocksChildren: Category disabled: all its tasks are blocked. Enable the category to use or edit its tasks.
LanguageData.WR_ParentMixedTip: *: tasks have different priorities. The parent shows their lowest non-zero priority. Editing the parent applies the new value to all its tasks and resets their exceptions. Middle-click to pick a value directly.
LanguageData.WR_ResetCategoryChildren: Restore all tasks in {0} to group value {1} for this pawn
LanguageData.WR_VerticalLabelsTip: Rotates category and task names by 90° and narrows their columns. Ctrl + left-click on a label still expands or collapses its tasks. Disable this option to restore horizontal labels.
LanguageData.WR_Expand: Ctrl + left-click the label to show this category's individual tasks.
LanguageData.WR_Collapse: Ctrl + left-click the label to hide this category's individual tasks.
LanguageData.WR_OrganizationHelp: Select a group on the left to display its children on the right. Drag rows within their list to reorder them, or use Move up / Move down. At equal priority, main order then child order break ties (emergency work retains its native pass).
LanguageData.WR_DragWithinList: Drag the ≡ handle within this list only. Click the name to select. To change level, use Make standalone / Return to group.
LanguageData.WR_OrganizationSaveNote: Draft until Apply. Shared organization, stored in this save. Each pawn keeps individual priorities.
LanguageData.WR_OrganizationNeedsGame: Load a game to organize its work. Organization is stored separately in each save.
LanguageData.WR_CurrentWork: Current work: {0}\nThe green frame marks the task this pawn is currently performing.
LanguageData.WR_ResetOrganizationTip: Restores the original category and child order and returns every standalone task to its original group. Individual priorities are preserved as when returning a task. Changes only the draft: Apply confirms, Cancel discards.
LanguageData.WR_MaximumPriorityTip: Limits available numbers. Applying a lower maximum reduces higher values to this cap in the current game, including parents and overrides. Raising it again does not recover previous numbers. This global setting is also enforced when loading games.
LanguageData.WR_InitialPriorityTip: A value between 1 and the maximum, initially 3 as in vanilla. Used for work the game enables for starting colonists and during new pawns' first work initialization. Does not change pawns in existing saves or the value used when reactivating a task. Initially disabled tasks stay at zero.
LanguageData.WR_GroupPriorityTip:
{0} editable pawns in this group.
Left/right click: change priority.
Middle click: choose a value.
…: different priorities between pawns.
*: different priorities between subtasks.
LanguageData.WR_GroupInherit: Restore child inheritance for eligible pawns
